title: LRanker: Scaling LLM Ranking to Millions of Candidates with Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2605.27810v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic representations for ranking, but processing candidate texts within limited contexts and repeatedly invoking an LLM for candidate-level comparisons can be costly when candidate pools contain millions of items. We propose LRanker, a framework for scaling LLM ranking to millions of candidates with test-time scaling. The framework combines two complementary components. A candidate aggregation encoder summarizes offline candidate embeddings using K-means clustering and conditions the LLM on compact global candidate information; ranking then uses inner-product scores with cached candidate embeddings. A graph-based test-time scaling mechanism allocates additional inference computation to partition-conditioned query embeddings and ensembles their ranking scores. translated_title: LRanker：通过测试时扩展将大语言模型排序扩展到数百万候选
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为排序任务提供了强大的语义表示能力，但当候选池包含数百万个项目时，在有限的上下文中处理候选文本、并反复调用LLM进行候选级别的比较，其代价可能十分高昂。我们提出了LRanker，一个通过测试时扩展将LLM排序扩展到数百万候选的框架。该框架结合了两个互补的组件：候选聚合编码器利用K-means聚类对候选嵌入进行离线汇总，并以紧凑的全局候选信息作为条件来引导LLM；随后排序通过缓存候选嵌入的内积分数来完成。基于图的测试时扩展机制将额外的推理计算分配给以分区为条件的查询嵌入，并对它们的排序分数进行集成。这将处理大规模候选池的评分能力与利用额外测试时计算提升排序质量分离开来。
tldr: LRanker通过K-means候选聚合编码器与基于图的测试时扩展机制，将LLM排序高效扩展至数百万候选规模并提升排序质量。
en_tdlr: LRanker scales LLM ranking to millions of candidates by combining a K-means candidate aggregation encoder with a graph-based test-time scaling mechanism to improve ranking quality.
